text: oh. and there might be other stats already defined and those all come with some may overlap
resolution: Addressed as part of req_0894. Surveyed the overlap before building: health/heat(=wanted source)/money/inventory already existed on PlayerState (armor was read by the HUD but never a real field), the wanted inputs already exist (activities heat + GAME_PERCEPTION notoriety), and the figure already has an OutfitDocument. The new GAME_STATS model BRIDGES to all of these (one source of truth) instead of duplicating: wanted derives from the live heat/notoriety scalar, outfit slots map onto OutfitDocument, and only the genuinely-missing pieces (armor, energy, wallet breakdown, carry-capacity factors, gained skills) are added. Documented in game/stats/CAPTURE.md.
